'''Camur''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3640 BBY]], who fought in the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Camur was assigned to [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel]]'s [[Shanra Immel's squad|squad]] and served with [[Republic Special Forces Division]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] during a [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|battle]] on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalandis Seven]]. Camur and the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] were tasked with the destruction of the [[Kalandis Seven's spaceport|local spaceport]], and after reaching the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], they were ultimately successful in their mission.

==Biography==
In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}} As "The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom" takes place after the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], and Malcom states it has been 40 years since the start of the [[Great Galactic War]] in [[3681 BBY]], the story must thus take place in 3640 BBY.</ref> Camur served as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. During a [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|battle]] on the desolate [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalandis Seven]], Camur was part of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel]]'s [[Shanra Immel's squad|squad]] and served with [[Republic Special Forces Division|SpecForce]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]]. During the battle, the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was tasked with the destruction of the local [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]&ndash;controlled [[Kalandis Seven's spaceport|spaceport]]. Along the way to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] they were attacked and [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Amden vor Keioidian]], a fellow member of Camur's squad, was [[Death/Legends|fatally]] wounded. Camur's sergeant, Immel, activated Keioidian's [[med tracer]] before leaving him behind.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

Three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] later, Camur and the squad reached their objective and checked in with Immel before proceeding with their mission. Malcom attempted to capture the Sith [[Command ship/Legends|Planetary command ship]] that recently landed, while Camur and the squad started planting their [[targeting beacon]]s, which would allow their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to destroy the spaceport regardless of the [[Water/Legends|fog]]. Shortly after, Malcom failed to capture the [[Command ship/Legends|command]] [[Unidentified planetary command ship|ship]] and the spaceport was destroyed by Republic fighters.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==Personality and traits==
Camur was [[Allergy/Legends|allergic]] to [[Caf/Legends|caf]].<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Camur's voice appeared in [[Alexander Freed]]'s short story "[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]" which was published in [[Star Wars Insider 137|''Star Wars Insider'' 137]]<ref name="TLBoCJM" /> and released on [[October 23]], [[2012]].<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/137|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #137}}</ref>
